name: bento-grid
title: Bento Grid
summary: Modular tiles of different sizes on a light canvas, each tile one idea. For product overviews, feature pages, portfolios, personal sites and launch pages.
imagery: Tight product crops, UI fragments, single objects on plain backgrounds; one image per tile.
rules: Build sections as a grid of tiles with one shared gap (16-20 px) and radius 20-28 px.
Vary tile sizes: one large hero tile, then a mix of wide, tall and small tiles; never a uniform grid of equal cards.
Each tile holds one idea: a big number, a short headline, an image or a small UI fragment.
Mix surfaces: mostly surface tiles, one tile-dark (text in on-dark) and one accent or tile-tint per section.
Headlines in Onest 600; body in Inter 400 15-16 px; tile labels in muted 13 px.
Padding inside tiles 24-32 px, content anchored to a corner rather than centred.
No shadows; tiles sit flat on the bg colour.
